data.notes: February 2026’s confirmed music calendar centered on Courchevel’s luxury dance-music circuit, with notable DJ bookings at BAÏES, La Mangeoire, Cat Club and Les Caves plus resort-run holiday programming.

events.title: WhoMadeWho at BAÏES Courchevel
events.summary: Bandsintown listed WhoMadeWho at BAÏES Courchevel, 540 Rue du Jardin Alpin, on February 4, 2026 at 7:00 PM. The Danish electronic act brought a club-focused live/DJ-oriented booking to Courchevel 1850.

events.title: Notre Dame at Cat Club Courchevel
events.summary: Shazam listed Notre Dame at Cat Club Courchevel on February 5, 2026 at 10:00 PM. The listing tagged the event as techno in Courchevel.

events.title: Deer Jade at La Mangeoire
events.summary: Shazam listed Deer Jade at La Mangeoire, Rue de Park City, on February 7, 2026 at 9:00 PM. The booking fits Courchevel’s upscale electronic and melodic house circuit.

events.title: GROSSOMODDO at Les Caves de Courchevel
events.summary: Shazam listed GROSSOMODDO at Les Caves de Courchevel on February 12, 2026 at 11:00 PM. The artist’s catalogue and collaborations place the night in an electronic/afro-house lane.

events.title: Carnaval de Courchevel 1850 DJ Animation
events.summary: Courchevel Tourisme confirmed Carnaval de Courchevel 1850 on February 17, 2026 from 14:30 to 17:30. The official programme included DJ animation alongside the parade, mask workshop and family activities.

events.title: BLOND:ISH at BAÏES Courchevel
events.summary: Shazam listed BLOND:ISH at BAÏES Courchevel, 540 Rue du Jardin Alpin, on February 18, 2026 at 9:00 PM. This was one of the month’s higher-profile dance bookings in Courchevel 1850.

events.title: Flamenco Recital Duo
events.summary: Courchevel’s official calendar confirmed a free Flamenco Recital Duo on February 18, 2026 from 5:30 PM to 7:00 PM. The concert featured Quentin Nedelcu on guitar and Mathilde Ménager on singing, dance and palmas.

events.title: Festival International d'Art Pyrotechnique - Courchevel 1650 DJ Animation
events.summary: Courchevel Tourisme confirmed the changed-date pyrotechnic festival evening in Courchevel 1650 on February 18, 2026 from 18:30 to 20:00. The programme began with DJ animation before the torchlight descent and ARDI fireworks show.

events.title: Themba at La Mangeoire
events.summary: Shazam listed Themba at La Mangeoire, Rue de Park City, on February 19, 2026 at 9:00 PM. The booking added an afro-house leaning dance night to Courchevel’s February club calendar.

events.title: Ofenbach Concert at the Millet Ski Touring Courchevel Final
events.venueName: Gymnase de l'Envolée / Courchevel Le Praz
events.summary: Courchevel’s official calendar confirmed the 16th Millet Ski Touring Courchevel fancy-dress final on February 25, 2026 from 6:00 PM, culminating in an Ofenbach concert at 9:00 PM. Spectator registration was offered online, with the concert following the awards ceremony at Gymnase de l'Envolée.

events.title: Rivo at Les Caves de Courchevel
events.summary: Shazam listed Rivo at Les Caves de Courchevel on February 26, 2026 at 11:59 PM. The event was presented as a dance concert/club booking at the late-night Courchevel venue.
